prompts.title: Review mobile onboarding
prompts.text: Use ui-ux-design-review to audit the current onboarding screens for touch ergonomics, a11y, loading/error states, dark theme and small screens. Give a prioritized actionable plan.

prompts.title: Evaluate a component before reuse
prompts.text: Use ui-ux-design-review to compare our existing patterns with the proposed component, noting keyboard behavior, responsive states, theming and integration trade-offs.
